evals.prompt: Implement one approved behavior using the iterative TDD skill and provide the iteration evidence.
evals.expected_output: One red-green increment with an external baseline, passing correctness and compliance grades, an iteration-scoped visual diff, and a stopped handoff.
expectations: Records plan approval before application edits
Captures a complete external baseline before edits
Shows the focused test failing for the expected reason before production work
Shows the focused test and required checks passing after implementation
Reports separate PASS verdicts for output correctness and process compliance
Stops after handing off the single increment

evals.prompt: The feature is correct, but implementation began before the plan was approved. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for process compliance regardless of output correctness.
expectations: Does not average the two dimensions
Identifies editing before approval as a critical failure
Does not mark the checklist item complete

evals.prompt: The implementation passes its tests, but there is no recorded failing test before the production edit. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL or UNVERIFIABLE for process compliance, never PASS.
expectations: Requires chronological red evidence
Does not infer red from the final passing test
Requests the missing or corrective evidence

evals.prompt: The workflow was followed perfectly, but one confirmed acceptance criterion is not implemented. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for output correctness even if process compliance passes.
expectations: Maps every criterion to evidence
Fails output correctness for the unmet criterion
Prevents an overall PASS

evals.prompt: A commit was created even though the user only asked for implementation and never authorized a commit. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for process compliance due to an unauthorized commit.
expectations: Does not treat implementation authorization as commit authorization
Names the unauthorized commit as a critical failure

evals.prompt: The visual diff compares repository HEAD with the working tree instead of the captured iteration baseline. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for process compliance because the diff may omit prior uncommitted work.
expectations: Requires matching baseline identifiers
Rejects HEAD as a substitute for the iteration snapshot

evals.prompt: A required check failed, but the handoff says all checks passed. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for output correctness and identify the inaccurate claim.
expectations: Uses the raw check result rather than the summary claim
Fails required validation
Calls out the inaccurate handoff

evals.prompt: The manifest omits the baseline and red-test evidence. Grade the increment.
evals.expected_output: UNVERIFIABLE unless raw evidence independently proves the missing facts.
expectations: Does not assume missing evidence passed
Lists the missing evidence
Prevents checklist completion

evals.prompt: The agent began iteration two immediately after the first handoff without human approval. Grade the second increment.
evals.expected_output: FAIL for process compliance and stop further work.
expectations: Requires continuation approval before the next baseline or edit
Treats the cross-turn violation as critical
